title: Get paid
headline: Get *paid*
sub: Send an invoice, and match the money when it arrives.

recap.en: A company has ordered ten tablets. Now, getting paid.
recap.pcm: One company don order ten tablets. Now, how to collect money.

bridge.en: Paid. Now Chiamaka's phone has to reach her today.
bridge.pcm: E don pay. Now Chiamaka phone must reach her today.

flow.action: Totals ten tablet boxes on a notepad with a pen, then taps his phone and nods in satisfaction
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter

flow.action: Slides a plain boxed phone and a charger into a small bag and seals it with a strip of tape

en: Okoro and Sons bought ten tablets.
Who it is for, and a phone number.
What it is for, and how much: one million, two hundred thousand.
Send it: they get a pay link by text.

en: Ikenna opens the tools, then Money.
The payment: one million, two hundred thousand.
He picks Okoro and Sons' invoice.
Match it, and it counts towards the invoice.
Back in Invoices, it shows as Paid.
